answer: Shared-outage linking: the ledger keeps each ID's pulse, one bit per epoch, answered or missed. Honest agents fail on their own schedules; clones on one server go dark together. Skip epochs where over 10% of IDs missed (a site-wide outage), then merge any IDs that missed the same 4+ of the last 168 epochs, and they split one reward. A farm must buy separate power and network per clone, or fake misses that cost real pay. Like rhyme in a sonnet, the pattern names the author; like umber stain on oak, it brings up the grain. Proposed thresholds, not measured.
